question: Can descent on the two known-point pair carriers sharpen the unresolved ranks of their two-isogenous product-character factors?
selection: Only pairs (01333,0b2d0) and (01333,19e45) from the frozen genus-five triple. Use its retained rational lift to parameterize the first conic. This is explicitly retrospective and does not select any new original parameter.
method: Reuse minimal_native_block_carrier.py unchanged. Compute each pair carrier's quartic Jacobian and one PARI effort-zero descent. Independently verify the degree-two isogeny to the previously computed product-character Jacobian.
failure_semantics: Timeout or unresolved descent leaves bounds only. Isogenous auxiliary curves share rank, not necessarily 2-Selmer or Sha dimensions.
boundary: This bounds auxiliary Jacobian ranks and the viability of rational-point methods. It is neither a rank predictor for original fibres nor a proof of global lifting from factor points.
